title: GalyVverse Task Email Dispatch Payload
description: A payload that forwards a Copilot/GitHub task from this hub to the Manus email channels (workflow email and/or taskbot email). Submitted via repository_dispatch (client_payload.task), workflow_dispatch inputs, issue events, or an inline JSON in the TASK_EMAIL_PAYLOAD environment variable. Recipient addresses are NEVER part of the payload — they are resolved at runtime from the MANUS_WORKFLOW_EMAIL / MANUS_TASKBOT_EMAIL secrets per connections.json routing.

subject.description: Email subject. CR/LF characters are stripped by the sender to prevent SMTP header injection.

body.description: Plain-text email body describing the task.

channel.description: Which Manus email channel(s) to send to. 'workflow' = MANUS_WORKFLOW_EMAIL (notifications), 'taskbot' = MANUS_TASKBOT_EMAIL (task intake), 'both' = both channels.

taskType.description: Category of the task being dispatched.

metadata.description: Arbitrary extra context (issue number, repo URL, labels). Serialized into the email body footer.

dryRun.description: When true, the sender only prints planned recipients and subject; no SMTP connection is made.
